title: Image URLs work in Vertex AI vision requests
summary:
Two text API fixes: image URLs reach Vertex AI vision models, and OpenAI request parameters survive parsing.

Vision requests can now pass HTTP image URLs to Vertex AI models, including `gemini-large`. The text pipeline fetches each image and converts it to a base64 data URL before sending it to the model.

Text API parsing no longer drops `max_tokens` and leaves requests at the default 2,048-token cap. It also preserves parameters including `max_completion_tokens`, `stop`, `logprobs`, and `n` for downstream model handling.
